title: Stalact - Act 2 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Stalact in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 2, Monoco's Station.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Colour of Lumina · Resplendent Chroma Catalyst

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Stalact is a rock-armoured boss whose elemental weakness flips depending on the stance it is currently in. It is the clearest example in the game of a fight where a static weakness chart is not enough.

sections.title: Where to Find the Stalact
sections.content: Location: Monoco's Station, Act 2. It also appears in the Flying Manor with the same stance mechanic.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances

Stalact's weakness is stance-dependent: Fire when it is in Ice Stance, Ice when it is in Fire Stance. Reading the stance before you commit a turn is the whole skill of the fight.

sections.title: How to Beat the Stalact
sections.content:
Read the stance first

Do not fire an elemental skill until you have checked which stance Stalact is in. Using the wrong element does nothing useful, and using the right one is a large multiplier - the difference between the two is the fight.

Its body is the target

Stalact is made of sharp blue rock with a drill-like head point. That head is the weak spot, and hitting it is how you break the fight open rather than chipping at the body.

  • Fire in Ice Stance, Ice in Fire Stance - never guess.
  • Aim for the drill head.
  • Because the key keeps flipping, bring both elements rather than committing to one.
